instruction: Google Earth KMZ placement The opened file `house.dae` is the source model. Place the house as a geo-located Google Earth model at San Francisco, orient it so the front of the house faces south, and save the result as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.kmz`. The source model contains a single-storey house with four separate geometries: outer walls, a pitched gable roof, a door panel, and a floor slab. Dimensions are in metres. The footprint spans X in `[0, 10]`, Y in `[0, 6]`, and Z in `[-0.1, 5]`. The front wall of the house is on `Y = 0` in the source model. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.kmz` must be a ZIP archive containing exactly these bundled model members: - `doc.kml` - `models\house.dae` The KML model placement must use: - longitude `-122.4194` - latitude `37.7749` - altitude `0` - heading `180` - tilt `0` - roll `0` - `Scale` values `x = 1`, `y = 1`, `z = 1` - `Link\href = models\house.dae` Requirements: 1. `C:\Users\user\Desktop\output.kmz` is a valid ZIP archive. 2. The ZIP contains both `doc.kml` and `models\house.dae` with those exact names. 3. `doc.kml` is well-formed KML with root namespace `http://www.opengis.net/kml/2.2`. 4. A `<Placemark>` is present and contains a `<Model>` element. 5. The model location uses longitude `-122.4194` and latitude `37.7749` within `1e-6`. 6. The orientation block uses heading `180`, tilt `0`, and roll `0`. 7. The model declares a valid KML `altitudeMode`. 8. The model `Link\href` is exactly `models\house.dae`. 9. The bundled DAE remains a valid model.
